headline: Candle graveyard (OP-D2/F10): 6/8 cells null as pre-registered; two surprises at |t|>2 -- doji_fwd5d (t=2.47) and 3down_fwd5d (t=3.02), not promoted signals.
caveats: Index-level (NIFTY50 daily, 2007-09..2026-04, n=4554 rows) only; patterns are fixed textbook OHLC-shape rules (no fitted parameters, no trend-conditioning for hammer/3down). Engulf combines bullish+bearish via sign-alignment to the textbook implied direction; doji has no directional prior so raw fwd return is used. fwd5d windows overlap (5 trading days), so daily observations are serially correlated and the plain one-sample t-test is not HAC/Newey-West-adjusted -- both TWO-SIDED surprises (doji_fwd5d, 3down_fwd5d) sit right at the |t|>2 threshold and should be read as flagged-for-follow-up, not confirmed effects; per the graveyard registration neither is promoted. All 8 registered cells ran (no MISS, all n>=30).
